theater: 喀爾巴阡盆地與多瑙河中游

battle.name: 匈牙利人入侵歐洲
battle.theater: 喀爾巴阡盆地與多瑙河中游
battle.brief: 匈牙利人自八六二年越過喀爾巴阡山進入多瑙河中游，先取潘諾尼亞，再兩度西進與南下：八九九年破法蘭克邊境直抵普羅旺斯，九五五年萊希費爾德敗於鄂圖一世。卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔所代表的閉面開眼盔型，工藝在拜占庭仍在延續，視線逼仄的代價正是披甲者只能靠隊形活。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭橫跨近兩個世紀，交戰方分成三組，但每組的內部形態都不一樣。匈牙利人（馬扎爾人）本身不是國家，而是七個大族以氏族為單位拼成的軍事聯盟，首領一系稱「久拉」或「庫恩」，戰時統兵者稱「卡爾恰什」，平時各部分散畜牧，遇戰才以血族為紐帶集合，所以他們的軍隊沒有固定編制，只有按部落湊集的人數檔，一檔約相當於一個村莊的三十二分之一。拜占庭帝國這邊是正規國家軍：帝都禁衛軍、京城大將軍與各軍區抽調的民兵構成主體，裝甲騎兵配鎖子甲或札甲，弓弩手與工程兵隨軍；元帥出動時通常帶一支能快速集結的精銳軍團。法蘭克與西哥德系的西法蘭克各王國以伯爵領地為作戰單位，奧托一世時代在多瑙河中游設「邊區」，由邊區伯爵率領民兵與騎士守線，後方是一串小型土壘與石堡。匈牙利人的敵人還包括第一保加利亞（先為盟友，後成仇敵）、波希米亞與波蘭諸公國，以及後期以「匈牙利王國」身分出現的匈牙利本身。教會勢力也介入了：拜占庭的希臘禮傳教士與拉丁禮的教區網絡先後進入喀爾巴阡盆地，東西兩套教會的角力，在八六二至一〇〇〇年間與每一次出兵同步進行。
countriesEn: The war runs across nearly two centuries, and the belligerents fall into three groups, though the internal shape of each group is quite different. The Hungarians, the Magyars, were not a state but a military alliance of seven great clans knit together at clan level: the leading house was called the gyula or the kun, the war leader the karchas. In peacetime the parts dispersed over their pastures and came together only for a war, so their army had no permanent establishment, only numbers of households assembled by tribe, the karcs, one karcs being about a thirty-second part of a village. On the Byzantine side was a proper state army: the imperial guard, the tagmata of the capital and the levies drawn from the themes formed the body of it, with armoured cavalry, the kataphraktoi, in mail or lamellar, and bowmen and engineers marching with them; a strategos who took the field normally brought a picked corps that could be assembled quickly. The Franks and the West Frankish kingdom of the Goths fought in units of county levies and knights; under Otto I a march was established on the middle Danube, with margraves holding the line with levies and knights, and behind them a chain of small earthworks and stone keeps. The Hungarians' opponents also included the First Bulgarian Empire, first an ally and later an enemy, the duchies of Bohemia and Poland, and eventually the Hungarian kingdom itself appearing as a party to the war. The Churches were drawn in as well: Byzantine missionaries of the Greek rite and the Latin diocesan network both entered the Carpathian basin, and the rivalry between the two unfolded alongside every campaign between 862 and 1000.
people: 最需要記住的名字有三類。第一類是匈牙利人一側的統帥：最早能與歐洲文獻對上的名字是阿爾莫什，九世紀末的編年史已把他寫成匈牙利軍隊的率領者；九五五年萊希費爾德一戰，匈牙利方面的統帥一般記作托克松尼，同時在場的還有布爾楚與萊赫爾，萊赫爾被俘後在雷根斯堡被倒吊致死，布爾楚的頭則被送回皇帝面前。第二類是敵方與盟邦的君主與將領：法蘭克王路易虔在位時最早接觸到匈牙利人的使者，查爾曼把匈牙利戰線交給奧托一世，奧托一世於九三三年在溫斯特魯特河取勝、九五五年再於萊希費爾德取勝，其弟巴伐利亞公爵亨利陣亡，匈牙利方面的萊赫爾也在此役被處死；拜占庭方面最關鍵的是「大將軍」巴爾達斯．福卡斯，他於九四三年冬天解了多瑙河畔要塞之圍；保加利亞的可汗西米昂與匈牙利人反目成仇；波希米亞的普雷米斯爾與波萊斯瓦夫一世先後在波希米亞邊境擊退匈牙利騎兵；波蘭的博萊斯瓦夫一世於九九八年攻入匈牙利，並擒住匈牙利王室成員阿爾莫什。第三類是做出關鍵決策的人：八六二年征服潘諾尼亞的行動、八九五年聯軍轉攻保加利亞的決策、與拜占庭談判每年進貢五千諾米斯瑪的使節，以及九九九年接受教宗派遣並受加冕的匈牙利君主——正是這些決定，把一次又一次的掠奪變成了國家的建制。
peopleEn: Three kinds of name matter most. First, the commanders on the Hungarian side: the earliest that can be matched with European documents is Almos, whom the annals of the late ninth century already write up as leading the Hungarian host; in the battle of Lechfeld in 955 the Hungarian commander is generally given as Taksony, and with him were Bulcsú and Lehel, Lehel being taken alive and hanged upside down at Regensburg, while the head of Bulcsú was carried back to the emperor. Second, the princes and generals of the other side: King Louis the Pious was the first Frankish ruler to receive Hungarian envoys, Charles the Bald entrusted the Hungarian front to Otto I, and Otto won at the Unstrut in 933 and again at Lechfeld in 955, his brother Henry the Duke of Bavaria falling in the fight and Lehel being executed there. On the Byzantine side the decisive figure was Bardas Phokas the Elder, the parakoimomenos, who relieved the fortress on the Danube in the winter of 943. The Bulgar khan Simeon was the great enemy of the Magyars; Přemysl and Boleslav I in Bohemia checked Hungarian riders on the Bohemian frontier in turn; Bolesław I of Poland invaded Hungary in 998 and took a member of the Hungarian ruling house, Almos, prisoner. Third, the individuals whose decisions turned raids into institutions: the decision to move into Pannonia in 862, the decision of the allied army of 895 to turn on the Bulgars, the envoys who negotiated the annual payment of five thousand nomismata to Byzantium, and the Hungarian ruler who in 999 accepted the mission sent by the pope and was crowned. Each of these turned another raid into a piece of state machinery.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是科林斯青銅盔：古希臘於公元前七世紀至六世紀盛行的全覆面青銅盔，只留兩道眼縫與一道鼻脊，盔體重約一點二至一點六公斤，鑲嵌與鍛接工藝繁複。它的血緣在歐洲並未中斷：君士坦丁堡的工坊到九、十世紀仍在仿製古典樣式的青銅盔，學界稱為「卡隆型」或「偽阿提卡型」，兩道眼縫與鼻脊的形制幾乎原樣承襲。卡面這頂盔真正象徵的，是「閉面開眼」這一整套邏輯——戴著它的人只能靠隊形活，而這正是匈牙利人最善於利用的弱點。匈牙利騎兵的裝備與卡面分屬完全不同的系統：木製複合反曲弓，張力大、拉距約六十至八十公分；單刃微彎的匈牙利彎刀與其前身短彎刀；長矛與可投擲的短矛；雙刃直身、長約八十五至九十五公分的匈牙利式短劍；皮甲、札甲與鎖子甲；小型圓盾與飾有金屬乳突的盾牌；頭上戴的是尖頂鐵盔或銅盔，附鼻梁，較早的北境戰場上則是毛皮或皮質頭巾配鐵片護額，閉面金屬盔在匈牙利軍中極為罕見。拜占庭這邊是札甲「克里瓦尼翁」、卡隆型開眼銅盔、圓盾、長矛與雙刃劍，並攜帶配重式投石機與弩砲；法蘭克與日耳曼諸軍是鎖子甲長衫、領巾式長盾、長矛、雙刃劍與帶鼻梁的鐘形盔；攻城方則靠木製雲梯、撞車與壕溝器械。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Corinthian helmet: the fully enclosing bronze helmet of archaic Greece, in use from the seventh to the sixth century BC, with two eye slits and a nasal, the shell weighing about 1.2 to 1.6 kilograms and requiring elaborate riveting and inlay work. Its bloodline in Europe was never broken: the workshops of Constantinople went on imitating the classical forms in the ninth and tenth centuries, producing what scholars call the Chalon type and the pseudo-Attic type, whose eye slits and nasal carry the pattern over almost unchanged. What the card's helmet truly stands for is the whole logic of the closed face with slit vision: the man who wears it can only live by the formation, and that was precisely the weakness the Hungarians were best at exploiting. The equipment of the Hungarian horsemen belonged to a different system entirely: a wooden composite reflex bow of heavy draw, some sixty to eighty centimetres; the single-edged, slightly curved Hungarian sabre and its shorter predecessors; lances and javelins, the kurica of old Hungarian; the Hungarian short sword, straight and double-edged, about eighty-five to ninety-five centimetres; leather, lamellar and mail armour; small round shields, some with metal bosses; and on the head a conical iron or bronze helmet with a nasal guard, or on the earlier northern battlefields a fur or leather cap with an iron brow plate. Fully enclosing metal helmets were extremely rare in Magyar service. The Byzantines had the lamellar klivanion, the slit-eyed bronze helmets of the Chalon type, round shields, lances and double-edged swords, and they marched with counterweight trebuchets and bolt throwers. The Frankish and German armies had mail hauberks, kite-shaped shields, lances, double-edged swords and bell-shaped helmets with a nasal. The besiegers brought wooden ladders, rams and ditching equipment.
tactics: 匈牙利人的打法是一套「騎射加消耗」的組合。第一步是不接戰的接觸：前鋒以小股騎兵貼近敵陣前沿，用密集箭雨與投矛削弱敵方陣線，隨即以假退拉開距離，把追出陣列的敵騎拖入早已排好的包圍圈；萊希費爾德之役中，匈牙利騎兵正是用這一著把鄂圖一世派出的騎兵隊單獨吃掉。第二步是消耗與拉平：他們不急於攻堅，而是用幾個月的巡迴把邊區的堡壘、屯田與援軍逐點吃掉，同時用遊騎封鎖道路，切斷敵方徵召與糧秣。第三步才是攻堅：下馬的步兵帶著梯子、木柵與長鉤攻堡，優先挑選守軍已被耗盡的目標。與此同時，拜占庭的守方用卡塔弗拉克托伊的密集重騎與工程兵的配重投石機解圍，這在九四三年多瑙河之役裡有紀錄；匈牙利人攻壘時則用雲梯、木柵與長鉤，與配重投石機在九四三年冬天的要塞攻防中被點名。法蘭克方面走向另一端：靠固定堡壘（土壘、石堡）、邊區民兵與小隊騎士拖住入侵者，溫斯特魯特之役中，奧托一世以夜行軍切斷退路、由兩翼收攏，把匈牙利與斯拉夫聯軍壓在河灣與沼澤之間。總之，進攻方的優勢是速度與機動，防守方的優勢是地形與紀律，而卡面那頂閉面開眼的青銅盔正是防守方裝備的象徵：它把個人變成隊形的一部分。
tacticsEn: The Magyar method was a combination of mounted archery and attrition. The first step was contact without engagement: outriders in small bands closed on the enemy front, thinned the line with showers of arrows and javelins, and then broke off in a feigned retreat, dragging any cavalry that pursued out of its formation into an encirclement already laid out; at Lechfeld the Magyar horsemen used exactly this device to destroy the mounted contingent Otto had sent out. The second step was to grind the enemy down and level the field: they were in no hurry to assault, but spent months circling the fortresses, the farms and the relief columns of the border, while flying columns cut the roads and severed the enemy's levy and supply. Only then came the assault: dismounted men with ladders, wattle and long hooks went against the walls, choosing first those targets whose garrisons had already been worn down. The Byzantine defenders answered with close ranks of kataphraktoi and with the counterweight engines of the engineers, which broke up the siege works of the Hungarians in the fortress fighting on the Danube in 943, where the Magyar assault with ladders, wattle and hooks is named in the sources. The Franks went to the opposite pole: they relied on fixed works, earthworks and stone keeps, on border levies and small bands of knights, to hold the invader in place, and at the Unstrut Otto I marched by night to cut the retreat, closing both wings and pressing the Hungarian and Slav allied host against the river bend and the marshes. In sum the attacker had speed and manoeuvre, the defender had ground and discipline, and the closed bronze helmet of the card stands for the defender's equipment: it turns the individual into a part of the formation.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點。傳統上匈牙利人進入喀爾巴阡盆地的年份記為八六二年，出自十三世紀的《匈牙利人的事蹟》；現代研究多把征服過程放在八六二至八九五年間，並指出具體起始月份並無記載，本篇取八月係按九世紀越嶺與作戰季節的通行做法推定。八九五年七月初，匈牙利聯軍在南部保加利亞擊敗西米昂，最終推進到君士坦丁堡城下。九九九年，匈牙利騎兵大舉西進，縱深進入今法國南部與義大利北部；法蘭克編年史記錄的進攻方向沿多瑙河谷往西，遠至塞納河與羅亞爾河，最遠處抵摩澤爾河上游。數字要特別小心：匈牙利編年史常把兵數寫到十萬或四十萬，現代學者則估計八九九年遠征的騎兵約在數萬之數；九五五年萊希費爾德之役，奧托一世的軍隊估計是步兵數千至一萬、騎兵數千，另有伊比利亞來的「羅馬人」騎隊，匈牙利方面的騎兵一般估在八千至一萬五千。九三三年溫斯特魯特之役的具體傷亡數沒有留下可靠記載。九四三年多瑙河之役中，拜占庭軍解圍後俘獲並處決了數千匈牙利人，翌年九四四年訂下的和約規定匈牙利每年向拜占庭進貢五千諾米斯瑪並歸還俘虜。距離方面，從匈牙利平原到維也根約一百五十公里，經維雷茨克山口翻越喀爾巴阡山至匈牙利以東約二百公里，順多瑙河而下至黑海口一線的商路約一千二百公里。尺寸方面，卡面青銅盔重約一點二至一點六公斤，匈牙利彎刀長約八十至一百公分，弓的拉距約六十至八十公分，長矛長二點五至三點五公尺。最後，一〇三〇年三月與皇帝康拉德二世所訂的松博爾和約，劃定了匈牙利與帝國在洪特河一線的邊界。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around a few nodes. The traditional year for the Magyars' entry into the Carpathian basin is 862, taken from the thirteenth-century Gesta Hungarorum; modern scholarship places the process of conquest between 862 and 895 and points out that the exact starting month is not recorded, so the month given here is reconstructed from the ordinary practice of crossing high passes and campaigning in the ninth-century season. In the first days of July 895 the allied Magyar army defeated Simeon in southern Bulgaria and drove on to the walls of Constantinople. In 899 Hungarian riders surged west, penetrating deep into what is now southern France and northern Italy; the direction of advance recorded by the Frankish annals runs up the Danube valley and west, as far as the Seine and the Loire and in places to the upper Meuse. The numbers demand care: the Hungarian chronicles habitually give hundreds of thousands, and modern estimates put the mounted force of the 899 expedition at some tens of thousands; at Lechfeld in 955 Otto's army is estimated at several thousand foot to ten thousand, with several thousand horse and the contingent of Iberians called Romans, and the Hungarian horse at eight to fifteen thousand. No reliable figure survives for the losses at the Unstrut in 933. In the Danube battle of 943 the Byzantine relief force captured and executed several thousand Hungarians, and the treaty of the following year, 944, laid down that the Hungarians should pay Byzantium five thousand nomismata a year and return their prisoners. As for distances: some hundred and fifty kilometres from the Hungarian plain to Vienna, about two hundred kilometres from the Verecke pass across the Carpathians to the east of Hungary, and some twelve hundred kilometres along the Danube to the trade route at the Black Sea. As for dimensions: the bronze helmet on the card weighs about 1.2 to 1.6 kilograms, the Hungarian sabre is eighty to a hundred centimetres long, the bow has a draw of sixty to eighty centimetres, and the lance runs from two and a half to three and a half metres. The last date worth keeping is the peace of Szombor of March 1030, which fixed the Hungarian frontier with the empire on the Hont river.
cause: 匈牙利人西進並非單一原因造成。第一層是草原的推力：八、九世紀之交，烏拉爾山脈西南的薩彥一帶已經容不下原有的畜牧組合，佩切涅格人與哈扎爾人西進、基馬克人南遷，馬扎爾人被迫離開原居地，向西進入可以容納更多牲畜的多瑙河中游。第二層是機會：拜占庭與保加爾在八五七年起的內戰中兩敗俱傷，匈牙利人先以傭兵身分加入拜占庭一方，八九四年兩國和解後反而變成對手，於是八九五年轉而把矛頭指向保加爾，並深入拜占庭境內。第三層是收益結構：草原部落的劫掠所得——擄獲的人口、牲畜與財貨——是整個聯盟維繫的前提，也是各氏族願意服從單一統帥的理由。第四層是外部壓力推動建國：法蘭克與拜占庭相繼要求匈牙利人接受基督教，匈牙利王國為了取得國際地位而採拉丁禮並接受加冕，於是每一次西征都不只是搶奪，也是在向帝國施壓、要求納貢並尋求承認。第五層是內部：八六二年後的征服本身破壞了原有的氏族平衡，只有不斷對外用兵，才能把龐大的部落聯盟維持成一個政治共同體。
causeEn: The westward movement of the Magyars was not the work of a single cause. The first layer was the push of the steppe: by the turn of the ninth century the Sayan region south-west of the Urals could no longer hold the pastoral combinations that had lived there, as the Pechenegs and Khazars moved west and the Kimaks moved south, so the Magyars were forced out of their old country and moved west to the middle Danube, where more animals could be kept. The second layer was opportunity: Byzantium and Bulgaria were both exhausted by the civil war that began in 857, and the Magyars entered first as mercenaries on the Byzantine side; when the two powers made peace in 894 the Hungarians became the enemy instead, and in 895 they turned on the Bulgars and pushed deep into Byzantine territory. The third layer was the structure of gain: the booty of the steppe raid, the captives, the animals and the goods, was the precondition that held the alliance together and the reason the clans obeyed a single commander. The fourth layer was outside pressure pushing the polity into being: the Franks and then Byzantium began to ask the Hungarians to accept Christianity, and the Hungarian principality needed standing abroad, so it took the Latin rite and a crown; every western campaign was therefore not only a taking of goods but also a way of leaning on the empire, demanding tribute and seeking recognition. The fifth layer was internal: the conquest of 862 itself had broken the old balance of the clans, and only continual campaigning could hold the large tribal alliance together as a political community.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了歐洲中東部的地形與權力。第一，喀爾巴阡盆地的語言、氏族與政權被整體替換：原有的斯拉夫部落、保加利亞式聚落與阿瓦爾殘餘逐漸退場，匈牙利人建立起以「蓋普伊」邊區、堡壘網與進貢關係為骨架的新秩序，語言與馬術在歐洲中東部落地生根。第二，東西歐的防衛體系被迫升級：八九九至九五五年間的襲擾迫使德意志與西法蘭克把土壘改建成石堡、把民兵改為有旗幟與固定編制的隊伍，邊區伯爵與修道院在防禦中權力上升，日後德意志王權的諸侯化由此起步。第三，羅馬帝國與西歐的政治版圖被迫重排：匈牙利人西征在九五五年萊希費爾德被擋下，之後其兵鋒轉向南方與東南，波蘭、波希米亞、摩拉維亞與基輔羅斯先後成為匈牙利的主要競爭者，直到十一世紀雙方才在多瑙河中游與南俄草原上反覆拉鋸。第四，宗教格局改變：八四〇至九五〇年間拜占庭希臘禮的傳教團進入潘諾尼亞與特蘭西瓦尼亞，與拉丁禮競爭，最後王國層級採拉丁禮並在一〇〇〇年由教宗派遣的使節主持加冕，匈牙利從此在西方眼中是「基督教盾牌」的一員，這個身分在蒙古西征時又被再次動用。第五，貿易路線重排：匈牙利成為歐洲通往拜占庭與黑海的最短通道，十一世紀以後帝國先後封鎖與匈牙利通商的路線，促成波蘭、捷克與基輔羅斯各自另尋出路。
impactEn: This war rewrote the map and the balance of power in central-eastern Europe. First, the languages, kindreds and polities of the Carpathian basin were replaced wholesale: the old Slavic tribes, Bulgar-type settlements and the Avar remnants faded out, and the Hungarians built a new order on the framework of the gyepű frontier, of the chain of forts and of tribute relations, and their language and their horsemanship took root in central-eastern Europe. Second, the defence systems of the West were forced to upgrade: the years 899 to 955 drove the Germans and the West Franks to rebuild earthworks as stone keeps, to turn levies into companies with banners and a fixed establishment, and the margraves and the monasteries gained power in the defence, which is where the seigneurialisation of the German monarchy began. Third, the political map of the Roman Empire and of western Europe had to be rearranged: the Magyar thrust west was stopped at Lechfeld in 955, after which their spearhead turned south and south-east, and Poland, Bohemia, Moravia and Kievan Rus became in turn the chief rivals of the Hungarians, who would spar with them for the middle Danube and the steppe of southern Russia through the eleventh century. Fourth, the religious map changed: Byzantine missions of the Greek rite entered Pannonia and Transylvania between about 840 and 950 and competed with the Latin rite, and in the end the kingdom took the Latin rite and was crowned in 1000 with a mission sent by the pope, so that Hungary appeared in Western eyes as a member of the shield of Christianity, an identity used again when the Mongols came. Fifth, the trade routes were rearranged: Hungary became the shortest road from Europe to Byzantium and the Black Sea, and after the eleventh century the empire closed the routes that led through Hungary one after another, which pushed Poland, Bohemia and Rus each to seek their own ways out.
result: 結果是分階段的。征服階段以八九五年攻下保加利亞南部、直抵君士坦丁堡城下告一段落，匈牙利人在盆地站穩腳跟，卻也暴露了正面戰力仍不足以與拜占庭交鋒的弱點。八九九年起是掠奪遠征的巔峰，法蘭克編年史連續記錄八九九至九〇一年間西法蘭克王國境內的城鎮與修道院被焚，帝國邊界退守到萊茵河與多瑙河上游。九〇七年匈牙利人在布拉迪斯拉發擊敗並殺死巴伐利亞公爵留托波爾德，九三三年溫斯特魯特河之役又被奧托一世打敗，河西壓力一度緩和。真正決定性的一役是九五五年八月十三日的萊希費爾德：帝國聯軍靠重步兵方陣與伊比利亞騎兵的側擊打散匈牙利騎陣，此後匈牙利人不再成建制地深入西歐，而是回到多瑙河中游，以劫掠巴爾幹、進攻斯拉夫公國與每年向拜占庭進貢為生。九九八年波蘭的攻勢與九九九年匈牙利內部的權力轉移，使伊什特萬在一〇〇〇年受加冕、一〇〇一年正式即位，匈牙利王國成立；一〇〇二年莫拉維亞的米什蒂沃伊在洪特河戰役被擊敗，一〇三〇年三月與康拉德二世訂下松博爾和約，邊界固定在洪特河。戰爭至此結束：匈牙利人留在多瑙河中游，成為帝國與拜占庭之間的基督國家，而「入侵歐洲」從此只在編年史裡留下名字。關於這些戰役的記載並不均衡：匈牙利方面的《匈牙利人的事蹟》成書於十三世紀，數字多有誇張；法蘭克編年史簡短而冷；保加利亞與拜占庭的史料又各有立場，考古發掘出的九世紀居室、馬具與武器，才是判定人數與裝備的基礎。
resultEn: The outcome came in stages. The stage of conquest closed in 895 with the Magyar army breaking the Bulgars in the south and riding to the walls of Constantinople; the Hungarians were now settled in the basin, but they had also shown that their strength in a set-piece battle was not yet equal to Byzantium's. From 899 came the peak of the raiding expeditions, the Frankish annals recording in the years 899 to 901 the burning of towns and monasteries in the West Frankish kingdom, while the empire's frontier withdrew to the Rhine and the upper Danube. In 907 the Hungarians defeated and killed the Bavarian duke Liutpold at Bratislava; in 933 they were beaten at the Unstrut by Otto I and the pressure west of the Danube eased. The decisive action was the thirteenth of August 955 at Lechfeld: the imperial host broke the Magyar horse with a solid block of heavy foot and a flank charge by the Iberian riders, and after that the Hungarians no longer entered the West of Europe in formed bodies, but turned back to the middle Danube, living on the plunder of the Balkans, the war against the Slavic duchies and the annual payment to Byzantium. The Polish campaign of 998 and the transfer of power inside Hungary in 999 led to the coronation in 1000 and the formal accession in 1001 of the first king of Hungary; the Moravian Mstivoj was defeated at the Hont in 1002, and in March 1030 a peace was concluded with Conrad II at Szombor that fixed the frontier on the Hont. There the war ends: the Hungarians stay in the middle Danube as a Christian state between the empire and Byzantium, and the invasion of Europe survives only as a name in the annals. The record of these wars is uneven: the Gesta Hungarorum was written in the thirteenth century and inflates its figures, the Frankish annals are short and cold, and the Bulgarian and Byzantine sources each have their own standpoint, so the archaeological evidence of ninth-century dwellings, horse gear and weapons is the true basis for judging numbers and equipment.
